page.overview:
What is Temerian Quarter?

The Temerian Quarter was a district of Loc Muinne assigned to the Temerian Army during the Third Northern War in , under the command of Interrex John Natalis.

Geralt only gets full access to it if he follows Roche's path. It is also there that he has his final meeting with Letho.
